# Setup

## Safety Checklist

- [ ] Check that __nothing is on or near the treadmill that should not be__ (i.e.people, cables, other robots, debris, parts, etc.)
- [ ] Ensure that if you are using the pulley that it is attached securely and correctly and is not tangled.
